concept: Review and integration: what having and respecting boundaries feels like so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of saying no, noticing unkindness, and protecting your body and things — which feels easiest, and which feels hardest?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what 'boundaries' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
